title: TagDuel 2v2 separate Field Zone and three-slot backrow visual integrity

implementation.behavior: For all four initial rotations, both teams hold a face-up certified Field Spell in the dedicated field property while all three Spell/Trap slots contain face-down Traps. PublicTagDuel exposes the Field Spell but only hidden backrow counts; renderTag fetches public Field Spell art and, in private views, only the selected physical viewer's hand. Set Trap identities and other hands are never requested.

limitations: Offline renderer/provider; no external art fetch or live Discord guild.
Uses certified Sogen and certified Trap definitions in deterministic temporary state; no production data.
This validates layout/privacy and does not certify a new card.
